# Prairie Shield Waterproofing & Foundation Repair

> Basement waterproofing, foundation repair and masonry contractor serving Chicago and the Chicagoland suburbs (Cook, DuPage, Lake, Will, Kane and McHenry counties). Free estimates, 24/7 emergency service, and a 30-year warranty on qualifying work (subject to written terms). Phone: (847) 269-2907.

Key facts:

- Business: Prairie Shield Waterproofing & Foundation Repair
- Website: https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/
- Phone: (847) 269-2907, answered 24/7
- Email: info@prairieshieldwaterproofing.com
- Service area: City of Chicago plus Cook, DuPage, Lake, Will, Kane and McHenry counties in Illinois
- Inspections and estimates are free, with no obligation
- Warranty: 30-year warranty on qualifying work, subject to written terms
- Insured and bonded; documents available on request
- The site does not publish fixed prices; estimates follow an inspection

## Waterproofing & Drainage

- [Basement Waterproofing](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/basement-waterproofing-chicago/): Stopping leaks, seepage and damp walls with interior drain tile, wall sealing, crack injection and sump systems.
- [Wet Basement Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/wet-basement-repair/): Finding where water gets in (cracks, floor joint, sewer backup or water table) and fixing the cause.
- [Sump Pump Installation & Battery Backup](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/sump-pump-installation/): Pump installation, replacement, battery backup systems and high-water alarms.
- [French Drain & Drain Tile Systems](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/french-drain-drain-tile/): Interior drain tile and exterior French drains that relieve hydrostatic pressure on the foundation.
- [Crawl Space Encapsulation](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/crawl-space-encapsulation/): Vapor barriers, sealing, drainage and dehumidification for damp crawl spaces.
- [Window Well Drains](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/window-well-drains/): Installing and repairing drains in window wells that fill with water.
- [24/7 Emergency Basement Flooding](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/emergency-basement-flooding/): Emergency response for failed sump pumps, storm flooding and active water.

## Foundation Repair

- [Foundation Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/foundation-repair/): Diagnosing and stabilizing settlement, cracks, sticking doors and uneven floors.
- [Foundation Crack Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/foundation-crack-repair/): Sealing leaking cracks and stabilizing cracks that show movement.
- [Foundation Crack Injection](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/crack-injection/): Epoxy and polyurethane injection that seals poured-concrete cracks through the full wall.
- [Bowed Wall Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/bowed-wall-repair/): Stopping inward-leaning basement walls, horizontal cracks and bulging block.
- [Carbon Fiber Wall Straps](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/carbon-fiber-wall-straps/): Reinforcing bowing basement walls from the inside.
- [Wall Anchors & I-Beam Bracing](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/wall-anchors/): Steel anchors and bracing for walls with more severe movement.
- [Helical & Push Piers](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/helical-push-piers/): Underpinning that transfers a settling foundation's load to stable soil.

## Masonry

- [Tuckpointing](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/tuckpointing/): Replacing failing mortar joints on brick homes.
- [Brick Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/brick-repair/): Repairing cracked, spalling and damaged brick.
- [Brick Replacement](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/brick-replacement/): Cutting out failed brick and replacing it with matched units.
- [Stone Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/stone-repair/): Repairing limestone, greystone and natural stone.
- [Stone Restoration](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/stone-restoration/): Cleaning, repointing and conserving greystones and historic facades.
- [Lintel Replacement](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/lintel-replacement/): Replacing rusted steel lintels above windows and doors.
- [Chimney Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/chimney-repair/): Leaning chimneys, cracked crowns, loose brick, flashing and leaks.
- [Chimney Rebuilds](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/chimney-rebuilds/): Full and partial rebuilds of deteriorated or unsafe chimneys.
- [Porch Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/porch-repair/): Settled, cracked and crumbling brick and concrete porches.
- [Step Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/step-repair/): Cracked, uneven and crumbling concrete and brick steps.
- [Concrete Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/concrete-repair/): Cracked, spalling and crumbling concrete.
- [Concrete Resurfacing](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/concrete-resurfacing/): Restoring worn and pitted concrete without full replacement.
- [Masonry Restoration](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/masonry-restoration/): Brick and stone restoration for aging buildings.
- [Masonry Cleaning](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/masonry-cleaning/): Removing soot, efflorescence, stains and graffiti from brick and stone.
- [Masonry Sealing](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/masonry-sealing/): Breathable water-repellent sealing for brick and stone.
- [Mortar Joint Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/mortar-joint-repair/): Rebuilding failing joints with matched mortar.
- [Block Wall Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/block-wall-repair/): Cracked, bowing and deteriorating concrete block walls.
- [Retaining Wall Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/retaining-wall-repair/): Leaning, bulging and failing retaining walls.
- [Parapet Wall Repair](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/parapet-wall-repair/): Rebuilding and repointing deteriorated parapets.
- [Commercial Masonry](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/commercial-masonry/): Facade, lintel and parapet work for commercial and multi-unit buildings.
- [Residential Masonry](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/residential-masonry/): Brick, stone and concrete repair for homes.

- [Foundation Warning Signs Homeowners Often Miss](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/foundation-warning-signs-chicago/): Sticking doors, sloping floors and small cracks that can point to foundation movement.
- [Foundation Repair After Heavy Rain](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/foundation-repair-after-heavy-rain/): How storms stress foundations and what to check afterward.
- [Concrete Foundation Repair in Chicago](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/concrete-foundation-repair-chicago/): Types of concrete foundation damage and the repair methods used.
- [Foundation Repair in Chicago](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/foundation-repair-chicago/): Causes, warning signs and repair options.
- [Which Foundation Cracks Need Repair?](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/foundation-crack-types/): Vertical, diagonal, horizontal and stair-step cracks explained.
- [Why Is My Basement Wet After It Rains?](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/why-is-my-basement-wet-after-rain/): Seven common causes and how to tell which one you have.
- [Interior vs Exterior Basement Waterproofing](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/interior-vs-exterior-waterproofing/): How the two approaches differ and which suits Chicago homes.
- [Sump Pump Maintenance & Battery Backups](https://www.prairieshieldwaterproofing.com/learning-center/sump-pump-maintenance-guide/): Testing a pump, failure signs and why a backup matters.
